source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.en: The bones which thou hast broken * may rejoice.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine, * oratiónem meam: ad te omnis caro véniet.
text.en: Lord, hear * my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.

text.la: A porta ínferi * érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: From the gates of hell * deliver my soul, O Lord.
Let everything that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Ego sum * resurréctio et vita: qui credit in me, étiam si mórtuus fúerit, vivet; et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non moriétur in ætérnum.
text.en: I am the resurrection and the life: * he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die.

text.la: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur:
text.en: O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for.
